quoteText: Any fool can write code that a computer can understand. Good programmers write code that humans can understand.
bioIntro: Full Stack Developer passionate about building modern, functional interfaces with an eye for the details that make a real difference in the user experience.
aboutP1: I'm Fernando Junior, a Full Stack Developer with 2+ years of experience, detail-obsessed and passionate about design that feels as good as it looks.
aboutP2: Fascinated by the full spectrum of creation, from UI/UX concepts and web design to component architecture and how users interact with functional, intentional interfaces.
aboutP3: I constantly come up with new project ideas and make a point of bringing them to life. I love exploring components, crafting beautiful interfaces, and turning rough concepts into polished products.

projectAstroVistaDesc: Open source app that explores NASA's space images and videos, archiving daily APOD images dating back to 1995.
projectOrbitDashboardDesc: Real-time analytics dashboard with interactive charts, data streaming, and advanced filters.
projectForgeApiDesc: High-performance REST API with JWT authentication, rate limiting, and automatic OpenAPI documentation.
projectPixelCanvasDesc: Collaborative real-time pixel art editor with public rooms, customizable palette, and PNG export.
projectStellarNotesDesc: Notes app with rich text editor, workspace organization, semantic search, and cloud sync.
projectVoidCliDesc: CLI tool for project scaffolding with custom templates, plugins, and npm integration.
companyDolphinDesc: Brazilian software company focused on technological solutions, developing AgroCRM, a complete platform for sales management and customer relationships for companies across various industries.
expDolphinFrontDesc: Developing a new AgroCRM platform using modern architecture, building a rich component library including comboboxes, date inputs, and file uploads. Working collaboratively with multiple developers in a monorepo, while also building from scratch a cross-platform mobile app with offline-first support using Expo and React Native.
expDolphinFrontBullet1: Built reusable form components and a cross-platform mobile app with offline sync from scratch
expDolphinFrontBullet2: Collaborated with multiple developers in a structured monorepo with MVVM architecture and strong DX practices
expDolphinBackDesc: Developed and maintained RESTful APIs using GeneXus, handling CRUD operations and backend optimizations in close collaboration with frontend and support teams.
expDolphinBackBullet1: Created and maintained CRUD operations with performance-focused optimizations
expDolphinBackBullet2: Worked closely with the frontend team to align API contracts and resolve integration issues
storyP1: I was born in <0>Mogi Guaçu, São Paulo, Brazil.</0> From a very young age, I have always been fascinated by technology, especially the internet. Over the years, this passion has only grown stronger, and it became clear that I would pursue a career in technology.
storyP2: I started a technical course in high school called Software Development, where I had my first real experience with programming and building projects on my own. It was then that I realized that what motivates me the most is creating things, bringing ideas from my head into the real world, whether through programming or other creative processes.
storyP3: Web technologies were my first gateway: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript helped me understand the fundamentals of logic and algorithms. From there, I decided to dive headfirst into the world of web development.
storyP4: Over the years, I have had the opportunity to work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express, and other technologies. I have also explored other areas of software development, such as mobile applications and backend development.
storyP5: Then I decided to pursue a degree in Systems Analysis and Development at <0>Fatec Artur de Azevedo,</0> where I was able to expand my knowledge and gain a deeper understanding of software development, algorithms, software architecture, software engineering, and other essential topics in the field, such as design patterns, testing methodologies, and requirements engineering.
storyP6: In my second semester of college, I had the opportunity to intern in customer support at <0>AgroCRM,</0> where I was able to apply my knowledge in real-world scenarios and gain valuable experience in the field. After 6 months, I transitioned to a backend development role using <1>GeneXus</1> and other technologies, such as SQL and REST APIs.
storyP7: After that backend experience, I transitioned to frontend development within the same company, where I started working with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Expo, and React Native, building everything from reusable form components to a cross-platform mobile app with offline-first support.
storyP8: And the rest is history! I continued working in the field of software development, gaining experience in various technologies and frameworks, and honing my skills as a developer. I had the opportunity to work on projects that challenged me and helped me grow as a professional.
storyP9: Today, I dedicate my time and energy to continuously improving my skills in modern technologies, frameworks, and platforms required by the industry. I love creating personal projects and collaborating with other developers who share the same passion for technology and innovation.
